name: ESD stations at strategic locations
description: Offshore Magazine reports a wellhead control panel and control and safety systems on the West Desaru WSS, and the cited API RP 14C training slides print a five-level shutdown hierarchy driven by manual, fire-and-gas and hydraulic-pressure inputs.
aliases: ESD stations at strategic locations (eg. boat landing, cellar deck, christmas tree area)

specifications.metric: Emergency shutdown (ESD) system and manu — shutdown levels
specifications.basis: Shutdown logic: Level 1 APS abandon platform; Level 2 ESD I total; Level 3 ESD II partial; Level 4 PSD total; Level 5 PSD partial

specifications.metric: Emergency shutdown (ESD) system and manu — levels of protection
specifications.basis: Premises for basic analysis and design include two levels of protection with primary and secondary activation order

specifications.metric: Emergency shutdown (ESD) system and manu — low-pressure sensor exemption length
specifications.basis: SAC A.1 Wellheads and Flow Lines: PSL installed; flow line segment between well and first choking device less than 10 feet (3 m)

specifications.metric: Emergency shutdown (ESD) system and manu — ESD actions on SCSSV
specifications.basis: ESD actions may include closure of SSVs and, where included in the engineered safety design, initiation of SCSSV closure

specifications.metric: Reliability — SIL 1 probability of dangerous failure on demand (low demand)
specifications.basis: PFD 0.1-0.01, RRF 10-100, low demand operation per IEC EN 61508 as printed in table

specifications.metric: Reliability — SIL 2 probability of dangerous failure on demand (low demand)
specifications.basis: PFD 0.01-0.001, RRF 100-1000, low demand operation per IEC EN 61508

specifications.metric: Reliability — SIL 3 probability of dangerous failure on demand (low demand)
specifications.basis: PFD 0.001-0.0001, RRF 1000-10,000, low demand operation per IEC EN 61508

specifications.metric: Reliability — SIL 4 probability of dangerous failure on demand (low demand)
specifications.basis: PFD 0.0001-0.00001, RRF 10,000-100,000, low demand operation per IEC EN 61508
